# ERRORS.md — ERROR-SURFACE TABLE (Phase C)

Mechanically derived from `c_src/src/lib.c`. Every distinct rejection /
early-out / sentinel-return / `STBDS_ASSERT` / range-or-null check in the C
source gets exactly one row. `STBDS_ASSERT` is `assert` from `<assert.h>` and
the cmake build defines **no** `NDEBUG`, so a failing assert calls
`__assert_fail` → `abort()` → `SIGABRT` (signal 6). The Rust translation maps
`STBDS_ASSERT(cond)` to `if !cond { abort() }`, so the observable outcome is
also `SIGABRT`. Rows whose trigger is a process-killing condition are checked
by forking a child (`std::process::Command` re-entering the test binary) and
comparing the **exit status / signal** of the C child against the Rust child.

`grep` used to enumerate the surface:

```sh
grep -nE 'return (-1|0|NULL|a;)|STBDS_ASSERT|assert\(|== NULL|!= NULL|== 0\)|if \(a ==|< 2\)|>= |<= |MIN|MAX' c_src/src/lib.c
```

| # | function | trigger (the exact invalid input/condition) | expected C result | test | status |
|---|----------|---------------------------------------------|-------------------|------|--------|
